author: Samuel Gibbs Consumer technology editor
lede: Slimmer, longer lasting and much easier to live with, new Oura sets a very high new bar for health-tracking wearables Oura’s new Ring 5 is a massive upgrade for smart rings, dramatically shrinking in size and weight to bring them right into line with standard wedding bands and other jewellery. It is finally a smart ring you can genuinely forget
title: Oura Ring 5 review: a stunning generational leap for smart rings
